units.name: Department of Finance and Supply Chain Management
units.evidence: Official department page states full name and remit across supply, production and distribution, including efficiency, resource optimization and supply-demand alignment.

units.name: Supply Chain Management Institute (SCMI)
units.evidence: Official institute page provides full name/acronym, applied supply-chain research mission and projects in logistics, electric-vehicle supply chains and supply-chain risk.

decisions.reason: Official IT department describes technology/administrative management; generic operations wording does not verify substantive operations-management remit. Separately verified supply-chain department and institute are retained without asserting equivalence.

sources.note: Complete college inventory; engineering housed in Education and Professional Studies.
Four business departments and parent hierarchy.
Full department name and operations scope.
Full institute name, acronym and research remit.

Engineering Technologies, Safety, and Construction department and full program inventory read. Electrical/mechanical technology, construction and safety; lean-manufacturing and ergonomics labs mentioned but no separate industrial-engineering unit established.

Imported department confirmed as IT management; areas primarily cybersecurity, IT leadership, analytics, IT projects and sustainable IT. Generic administrative operations wording does not establish a substantive OM/OR/SCM unit.

limitations: Engineering laboratory activities do not establish a separately named Industrial Engineering unit; none added on that basis.
